_meta.purpose: UPS-path A/B labeled set for the identifier-exact-match floor-bypass (CLAUDE_MEM_UPS_IDENTIFIER_BYPASS). Run via benchmark/ups-ab.mjs against the REAL projects--mem corpus.
_meta.construction: positives = real imp>=2 obs whose title carries a camelCase/snake_case identifier, phrased as an explicit recall question naming that identifier; expected = that obs (mostly low cited_count, i.e. floor-gated in control). hard_negatives = the TRUE precision test (#8858): (a) prompts naming a GENERIC compound field (created_at / files_modified / created_at_epoch) that collides across many UNRELATED obs, so any injection is a true off-topic match; (b) signal-less prose where the bypass must NOT fire. topical_eager = prompts naming a SPECIFIC identifier whose matching obs is on-topic-but-unrequested — eagerness, NOT a true FP (#8858 warns against counting these as precision cost); reported separately, excluded from the verdict. Per-query output is printed for audit.
_meta.ids_are_live: obs ids reference the live DB at snapshot_date; re-derive if the corpus drifts.
